notes.title: Update 1.5.1
notes.content:
Bonjour!

I'm happy to inform you that Little Comet now supports French. Amusez-vous bien!

-Markus

notes.title: Update 1.5
notes.content:
Hello cometeers!

Hope your time in social separation has been going well. Personally I have been stuck with my two lovely daughters (7 and 5) for months now and it's been... um... let's just say that I haven't gotten much work done.

That said, I did still manage to make a small update for Little Comet. You can now impress your friends with your comet slinging skills and Steam achievements!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33915429/3b953b740542dc22d3515f2dbe35ecbf0b08048c.png

For the time being, all the achievements are tied to your progress, but there could some more interesting ones in the future. The game has some fun achievement possibilities, but they all require considerable amount of extra work, so no promises on when or if they will be published.

Lastly, thanks for playing, and stay strong during these difficult times <3

Yours,
Markus

notes.title: Update 1.4
notes.content:
Greetings cosmic travelers!

Release 1.4 is mostly about some small UX improvements. Here's the full change log:

You can now start slingshotting from anywhere on the screen
Increased the length of the slingshot to give you more control over the strength
In-game UI is now white instead of orange, making it more visible against some backgrounds
All courses now have an icon in the course select, making it easier to find your favourites
The tutorial glove in course 1-2 is now a bit smarter and hopefully a better teacher
Added music to the title screen

notes.title: Update 1.3
notes.content:
Privyet!

1.3 is a minor update containing a couple of new features:

Russian language support 
Fart sounds
A completely redesigned 12-4 (the last Sun course)

notes.title: Update 1.2.2
notes.content:
Hi,

1.2.2 is a patch release with some small fixes and improvements.

Most notable change is that the game now uses the desktop resolution in full screen mode, making it look nice and sharp. You can override the automatic resolution setting using the command line arguments -show-screen-selector +noautores

-Markus

notes.title: Update 1.1
notes.content:
Olá!

Thanks to Digital Kaz Brazil, Little Comet now supports Brazilian Portuguese!

Here's the full change log for version 1.1:


Portuguese translation
Improved dialog visuals
Credits dialog (can be opened from the Settings view)
Fixed wall coloring issue in 5-3
Fixed incorrect gravity range of some moons in 5-4
Made Rocky a bit easier to win


-Markus
